verdict.rationale: YPOG publishes free explainer briefings on its own site. They cover early-stage financing instruments (CLAs, SAFEs, ASAs and when a priced round fits better) and equity (ESOP taxation under the Future Financing Act and Section 19a, plus alternatives to VSOPs). For formation, it offers a free GmbH starter kit and foundation questionnaire, and a Venture Deals in Germany page covers cap tables and deal terms. Missing for 10: evidence of an organized knowledge-base hub or FAQ format; formation material is forms and checklists rather than plain-language explainers; no independent corroboration of how accessible or comprehensive the content is.
